messages.content: 我想在聖荷西附近的Walmart買蘋果、米飯和12罐瓶裝水。請顯示產品資訊和庫存情況。

function.name: walmart_purchase
function.description: Retrieve information of items from Walmart including stock availability. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

product_list.description: Items to be purchased listed in an array.

pack_size.description: Size of the product pack if applicable. The size of the array should be equal to product_list. Default is not use it if not specified.

message.reasoning:
The user wants to buy apples, rice, and 12 cans of bottled water near San Jose Walmart. They want product info and stock status. We need to call the function walmart_purchase with location "San Jose" or "San Jose, CA" and product_list ["apples", "rice", "bottled water"]. For bottled water, they want 12 cans. The function signature includes optional pack_size array. We need to specify pack_size for each product. For apples and rice, pack_size not needed. For bottled water, pack_size should be 12. But pack_size array length should equal product_list length. So we need to provide pack_size: [null, null, 12] or maybe 0 for not used. The function expects pack_size?: number[]. So we can provide pack_size: [0, 0, 12] or [null, null, 12]. But number[] cannot contain null. So we can provide [0, 0, 12] or [1, 1, 12] but 1 might be ambiguous. The spec says default is not use it if not specified. So we can provide pack_size: [12] only? But length must equal product_list. So we need to provide pack_size array of same length. We can provide [0, 0, 12] to indicate no pack size for first two. That might be acceptable. Or we can provide [undefined, undefined, 12] but undefined not allowed in number[]. So best to provide [0, 0, 12].

Thus call function.
